plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky Bash commands (rm -r, force push, reset --hard, clean, find -delete, drop/truncate), shows what they would affect, and waits for Proceed or Cancel.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Holds a prompt once when the prompt cache has gone cold and shows the estimated re-write cost; /keepwarm pings the cache.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: Project file tree in a pane: files Claude reads or edits shimmer, committed ones turn green, uncommitted changes are marked. Toggle with /filetree.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Hands a long session over to a fresh one before context runs out: watches the context fill, offers to write HANDOFF.md from the session's own transcript, and loads it into the next session.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Turns your corrections into saved rules: spots a stated preference in your prompt and offers to save it to CLAUDE.md from a band above the prompt.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: /replay steps through every file edit Claude made in the last turn, one colored diff at a time.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Live panel and progress band for subagents: model, context fill, tokens, estimated cost and time. Toggle with /agents-info.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Switch colour skins live with /skin <name>: tool rows with icon, name, argument summary and duration, edits as diff cards, a styled spinner.

plugins.name: you-should-know
plugins.description: A second agent on the side reads what Claude just did and flags anything you might miss, as a note above the prompt. Toggle with /should-know.
